notes.title: Alpha 211007 / Update
notes.content:
[h1][b]Map changes:[/b][/h1]
[b]- replaced all houses on the map[/b]
[list]
We have been planning to redo all the houses in the game for a long time, without this change we could not further develop the map.
New houses have a system of random generation of walls, windows, the number of floors, the color of facade and loot inside.
This means that all villages will look different every time, the position of the houses will not change, but they will look different. Also, due to the random generation of spawn points of loot in houses, looting will require more care, because you will have to inspect every piece of furniture in the house.

Friends! Thank you for your feedback! Now we know what to focus on.
Please, you will make our task much easier if you write the bugs that you have found, shortcomings and questions to the appropriate topics. After all, to understand how to control the gears of the car, it's enough just to look into the settings, and to answer the question of where to get a log, it's enough to ask in the topic on the forum. And we were somewhat surprised that some people had a problem with this, because to find an axe in some village and cut down a tree - it's super easy :)
